author: chromealt
text:
FAU’s Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science is hosting a virtual workshop this Friday: From Technical Expert to Mission-Ready Leader, led by Mo Civers-Davis, U.S. Air Force veteran and former Department of the Navy civilian.

The session covers leadership skills plus internship opportunities with DoD agencies, with an emphasis on cybersecurity. If you’re interested in government cyber or tech roles, this is one you don’t want to miss! Anyone thinking about applying to the CyberCorps SFS program should definitely attend too.

Virtual
October 23rd from 1 to 2:30 PM ET
Register here: https://tinyurl.com/fau-leadership

Florida Atlantic's Cybersecurity Club at the College of Engineering and Computer Science has a guest speaker coming this Thursday: Kyle Ryan, Red Team Tech Lead in the energy sector and former cyber warfare professional.
Kyle is a very smart guy with a lot to share about offensive security and what it looks like in the real world. Don't miss it!

📍 Student Support Services (SU-80) Building, Room 220
🕒 October 22nd from 6-7 PM
🔗 Linktree in bio for all the details
